description: Election Commission - Elected Mr. O. M. N. Perera as Vice Chairman, of the Boralesgamuwa U/C - Elected Mr. S. P. S. Ariyachandra as the member of ward No. 01 Pepiliyana and Mrs. S. P. Gamlath as the member of the ward No. 02 Divulpitiya of Boralesgamuwa P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Boralesgamuwa Urban Council) due to deaths, including the Vice Chairman position and council member positions. The notices are made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involve electoral processes for local government positions, making this clearly fall under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including filling vacancies and declaring elected members.
